## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed (if applicable). Include any relevant motivation and context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] New Operator / Engine (see checklist below)

## PR Checklist (General)
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have run `make check-all` and everything passes

## PR Checklist (New Operators / Engines)
If you are contributing a new evolutionary engine or genetic operator, please ensure:
- [ ] **JAX Compliance**: The component is entirely compatible with `jax.jit` and `jax.vmap`.
- [ ] **Flax Structs**: The component inherits from the correct base class (`BaseMutation`, `AbstractEngine`, etc.) and is decorated with `@flax.struct.dataclass`.
- [ ] **Scaffolding Validation**: I have included a test suite (similar to the one generated by `make scaffold`) proving the component instantiates and runs without JAX tracer errors.
- [ ] **Metadata**: I have used the correct `@register_*` decorator and included `compatible_genomes` and `compatible_engines` where applicable.

## Additional Notes
Add any other context about the pull request here.
